changes.text: Weigh a spool on a kitchen scale and SpoolKid works out what filament is left.
Previous measurements are listed on the spool, including ones recorded by FilaMan.
Search now matches your words across every field instead of the whole phrase against one.
Every scan routes to the Scan Result Hub, whichever backend and settings you use.
The spool form explains why a weight mode is unavailable instead of showing nothing.
